records.name: Day Base
records.tagline: Build a database for anything
records.description: Day Base is a customizable database designed to help you keep track of anything you collect or manage, from books and inventory to travel, recipes, plants, and clients. You can design your own data schema, or paste any spreadsheet (CSV, Excel) and Day Base will automatically build the schema for you. Additionally, you can add records hands-free using Siri and Shortcuts. Rest assured, your data remains private and secure in your iCloud, with no account, server, or third party accessing it.

records.name: Fliko
records.tagline: Share sensitive files. Leave no copies behind.
records.description: Most sensitive data doesn't leak because of hackers. It leaks because we share it. Fliko lets you send files and notes that automatically expire. Share by link, QR code, or email, set when access ends, and the content is permanently deleted when the timer runs out. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: Extract Mails
records.tagline: Extract emails faster and streamline your outreach.
records.description: Extract Mails is a smart email extraction tool that helps users collect and organize email addresses efficiently. It streamlines lead generation, outreach, and contact management, making it easier to connect with the right audience and grow business opportunities.

records.name: Balloon Run
records.tagline: Fun game, outrun the cops, hit the targets, avoid obstacles
records.description: The road never ends — and neither does the chaos. Balloon Run is a fast, addictive 3D arcade runner. Weave through traffic at full speed, lob water balloons at roadside targets, and outrun a relentless police chase — all with one thumb on the wheel and one on the slingshot.

records.name: StorageBites
records.tagline: Pay for what you need
records.description: Cloud storage with plans that actually match what you need, from 100GB up to 1TB. No huge jumps, no paying for space you will never use.

records.name: GitSync for macOS
records.tagline: Visual GitHub management directly from a graphical interface
records.description: GitSync is a macOS app for visual Git/GitHub management directly from a graphical interface. You can sync local projects with GitHub, clone repositories, create new repositories, and run common Git workflows without using the terminal.

records.name: MacroMate Recorder
records.tagline: MacroMate Recorder automation tool designed for macOS.
records.description: MacroMate Recorder is a macro automation tool designed exclusively for macOS. The software functions to record and playback repetitive workflows on a Mac—such as mouse movements, clicks, and keyboard strokes—allowing users to save time without requiring any programming or coding skills. Key Features Smart Macro Recording: The application can accurately capture mouse movements, various clicks, text inputs, and complex keyboard shortcuts. Auto Loop & Play

records.name: OPUS Studio management for artists
records.tagline: The all-in-one workspace for working artists
records.description: Opus is the studio management app built for artists, curators, galleries, and collectors. Track projects, materials, and budgets. Catalog artworks with full media and provenance. Design exhibitions in a 2D/3D floor-plan editor and share them. Never miss a grant or open call. Work in the cloud to sync across devices, invite your team, and collaborate in real time. Plus an AI Art Agent that remembers your practice and surfaces opportunities.

records.name: Idees: Beautiful Notes
records.tagline: KI-Notizen mit Zero Knowledge.
records.description: Note: German language, only in DE & AT App Store. Kostenlos & werbefrei (ausser Eigenwerbung), nur die optionale KI-Hilfe kostet extra. Komplett nach „Privacy-First“ (lokal/iCloud) entwickelt mit edlem Premium-Design. Schönes UI, lokales KI-Gedächtnis für Ideen. Verschiedene Möglichkeiten Notizen fest zu halten. Von einem Studenten gebaut.

records.name: Chatio
records.tagline: Free Forever CRM with WhatsApp Marketing & Automation
records.description: Chatio is a free forever CRM built for businesses that use WhatsApp. Manage customers, collaborate with your team through a shared inbox, send bulk WhatsApp campaigns, automate workflows with no-code flows, track sales pipelines, and organize contacts in one platform. Unlike many CRM tools that require expensive subscriptions, Chatio provides powerful customer management and WhatsApp marketing features at no cost, making it ideal for startups, agencies, and growing businesses.

records.name: PacksMC
records.tagline: Upload once. We convert, render, and publish it all.
records.description: PacksMC is a site for Minecraft texture packs. Creators upload their work, we sort everything by game version so you're not downloading a pack that breaks on load, and you grab whatever you want for free. Around 300k+ people already use it a month.

records.name: 11 MTD Bridge
records.tagline: HMRC-recognised Making Tax Digital (MTD) software for UK
records.description: HMRC-recognised MTD bridging software for VAT returns and Self Assessment. File directly from spreadsheets and pay per filing with no subscription.

records.name: Slackbot’s MCP Client
records.tagline: Work across 20+ apps in Slack with multiplayer collaboration
records.description: Slackbot’s new MCP Client ends fragmented AI work by connecting 20+ apps (Atlassian, Linear, Canva, Zoom) to one conversational interface. Ask Slackbot in plain language to act across tools—sign docs, update tickets, view dashboards—then share results in team channels for true multiplayer collaboration.

records.name: Reframe
records.tagline: Surf like it's 1999
records.description: Reframe is an open-source browser based on Electron for macOS that brings back the look & feel of Safari 1.0, Netscape 4.8, Firefox 1.0 and Internet Explorer 5.0, with a built-in Wayback Mode.

records.name: WorkClaw
records.tagline: Collaborative, proactive AI coworkers who work in Slack
records.description: Meet the AI team for your team. WorkClaws are collaborative, proactive AI coworkers who work in Slack and Microsoft Teams just like every other colleague. They're fully customizable to get work done your way by learning skills and routines. Unlike most AI products that pair one person with one assistant, WorkClaws can collaborate 24/7 with your whole team. Each Claw has a job title, a manager in your org chart, and a cloud-hosted ClawOS computer with the ability to access more than 3,000 apps.

records.name: ComplaintFinder
records.tagline: Find SaaS Opportunities Hidden In Customer Complaints
records.description: Discover untapped SaaS ideas by mining real customer complaints. Enter a market, get opportunity scores, ideas, and SEO keywords.

records.name: Crompt AI Chrome Extension
records.tagline: One Chrome extension. Multi-AI models. Zero tab-switching.
records.description: Crompt AI is a Chrome extension that brings GPT, Claude, Gemini, & Grok into one side panel — no more tab-switching or multiple subscriptions. Access 20+ AI models, generate images, summarize YouTube videos & web pages, analyze data, write emails, execute code, and enhance prompts — all without leaving your current page. One extension. Every AI model. Zero friction. Install free & try 20+ Multiple AI models like GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok in one click

records.name: WebDAV Lite - LAN File Server
records.tagline: Instantly turn your Mac into a lightweight WebDAV server.
records.description: WebDAV Lite turns any Mac folder into a secure WebDAV server via a simple menu-bar app. Perfect for fast local file syncing and media streaming to apps like Infuse, VLC, or Finder. Key Features: - Instant Setup: One-click folder sharing, no complex configuration. - Menu-Bar Native: Lightweight and runs completely in your top menu bar. - Fully Compatible: Supports full read/write & lock/unlock actions. - Secure: Includes TLS encryption and password protection.

records.name: TogglDev
records.tagline: TogglDev - One tap Developer options for Android users
records.description: 1. One tap toggle to Developer options on Android 2. Automated toggle so banking apps never fail 3. Easy automation 4. Play store protected 5. 100% free, Zero ads.
